m: 1. एष् (probably connected with 3. इष्) cl. 1. P. Ā. एषति (Impv. एषतु p. एषत् inf. एषे), -ते, एषां-चक्रे, एषिता, &c., to go, move, Dhātup. xvi, 17; to creep, glide, RV. x, 89; 14; AV. vi, 67, 3; to glide or hasten towards, attain, obtain, RV. v, 41, 5; 66, 3; 86, 4.
2. एष् (आ-√ ईष्) P. Ā. -ईषति, -ते, to hasten near or towards, fly at; to endeavour to reach or obtain; to desire, request, RV.
a: एष् — {c1c} U. (एषति-ते, एषितुं, एषित) 1 To go or approach. --2 To hasten towards, fly at, attack any one. --3 To endeavour to reach or gain. --4 To request. --5 To desire. --6 To creep or glide.

s: strI, (izu Sa vAYCe + wAp .) icCA । iti jawADaraH ॥ etadSabdasya strIliNge'pi rUpamidam ॥
m: एषा f. wish, L.;

v: puMstrI । ezAyAM yaTezwaM DanAdipratigrahecCAyAM vIraH । yataH kutaScit pratigrAhake ninditabrAhmaRaBede । striyAM jAtitvAt NIz । “yadyenamEzAvIrA yAjayeyuH” Sata॰ brA॰ 11, 2, 7, 32, “ezAvIronAma ninditabrAhmaRajAtiviSezaH tatsaMbanDina ftvijaH” BA॰

m: एषैष्य mfn. to be sought for, desirable, RV. x, 102, 11.
accord. to some the word is एषैष, ‘impetuous’, and ˚ष्या the instr. of the fem. ˚षी.

s: f Na gatO । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ BvAdiMAtmaM-sakaM-sew .) f mA BavAn ezizat । Na ezate । iti durgAdAsaH । (yaTA, BAgavate 3 । 14 । 45 । “sa vE vata BrazwamatistavEzate yaH karmmaRAM pAramapArakarmmaRAm” ॥)
puM, purovarttipuruzaH । etadSabdasya puMliNge praTamEkavacane rUpamidam ॥
m: 1. एष mfn. gliding, running, hastening, RV.
2. एष (nom. m. of एतद्, q.v.)
3. एष mfn. (fr. √ 3. इष्) ifc. seeking, ŚBr. xiii
एष m. the act of seeking or going after, RV. x, 48, 9
(एष), wish, option, RV. i, 180, 4, (cf. स्वैष)
एष [cf. Zd. aêsha; O. H. G. ērā.]
a: एष — a. 1 Desirable, to be desired. --2 Gliding, running; epithet of Viṣṇu. --षः 1 Running or hastening towards. --2 Seeking. --3 Wish, choice. --षा Wish, desire.

m: एषणा f. seeking with, desire, begging, solicitation, request, ŚBr.; Pāṇ.; Rājat. &c.
(with Jainas) right behaviour when begging food, Sarvad. 39, 9
एषणा-समिति f. correct behaviour when begging food, HYog.

m: एषणी f. an iron or steel probe, Suśr.
a goldsmith's scale, L.

m: एषणीय mfn. to be sought or aimed at, desirable, Kum.
ifc. belonging to the medical examination of Suśr.
a: एषणीय — pot. p. 1 To be desired or desirable; Ku. 7. 88. --2 To be aimed at or sought. --3 To be approached. --4 (At the end of comp.) Relating to medical examination.

s: puM, (iz + lyu .) lOhamayabARaH । iti halAyuDaH ॥ (yaTA, BAgavate 7 । 9 । 39 । “kAmAturaM harzaSokaBayEzaRArttaM tasmE kaTaM tava patiM vimf Sami dInaH” ॥)
v: pu॰ ezate Satruhfdayam lyu । 1 lOhamayavARe halAyuDaH । iza icCAyAM Ric BAve--yuc । ezaRA 2 preraRAyAM 3 putralokavittakAmanAyAYca strI “na kaScidanyaH paMsAra uktAdastyezaRAtrayAt” vedA॰ । “tamAtmAnaM viditvA vrAhmaRAH putrezaRAyASca vittEzaRAyASca lokEzaRAyASca vyutTAyATa BikzAcaryyaM caranti । yA hyeva putrEzaRA sA vittEzaRA yA vittEzaRA sA lOkEzaRoBe hyete ezaRe BavataH” Sata॰ brA॰ 14, 6, 4, 1, “putrEzaRA putrotpattimuddiSya dArasaMgrahecCAlakzaRA । vittaM dviviDaM mAnuzaM gavAdi, dEvaM vidyAdi, tasya karmmaRA sADanasya gavAderupAdAnarUpA icCA vittEzaRA'nena karmma kftvA pitflokaM jyezyAmIti vidyAsaMyuktena vA devalokam । kevalayA vA hiraRyagarBavidyayA devena vittena devalokaM jezyAmItIcCA lokEzaRA । evamekatve'pi lokEzaRAyAH sADanamantareRAsidDeH sADyasADanABedena dvEviDyamAha uBe hIti” BA॰ । “apahatasakalEzaRAmalAtmanyaviratameDitaBAva nopahUtaH” BAga॰ 4, 31, 18, ezyate jYAyate mAnamanayA karaRe lyuw NIp ezaRI । 4 tulAsADane (nikti) mAnayantraBede mediniH । svArTe kan । ezaRikA'pyatra । amaraH । ezate vraRapAramanayA karaRe lyuzw NIp । (velakAra) 5 vraRasPowanAstraBede medi॰ । BAve lyuw । suSrutokte 6 vraRavidAraRavyApAraBede । tatra hi “yantrakarmmARi tu niryyAtanapUraRetyAdyupakrame “cUzaREzaRadAraRetyAdi paWitvA caturviMSatirityuktam । tatra ezaRamaByantare SastrapraveSanena pUyAderapasAraRam । tatsADanaSastramezaRI yaTA ha suSrutaH “viM SatiH SastrARi tadyaTA maRqalAgrakarapatretyAdyupakrame “vaqiSadantaSaNkvezaRI” ityuktvA “ezaRyezaRe Anulomye ca” iti tatprayojanamuktam । ezaRamaByantaragamanamAnulomyaM visrAbaRam tatrEva ezaRIlakzaRaM “ezaRI gaRqUpadAkAramuKI” uktam । “ezyezvezaRyalABe tu bAlANgulyaNkurA hitAH” muSrutaH ।
m: 1. एषण f(आ)n. impulse, ardent desire, BhP.
2. एषण mfn. seeking for, wishing, Nir.
एषण m. an iron arrow, L.
एषण n. the act of seeking, begging, solicitation, MBh.
medical examination, probing, Suśr.
a: एषण — a. Seeking. --णः An ironarrow. --णं 1 Seeking. --2 Wish, desire. --3 Driving, pressing. --4 Probing. --णा 1 Seeking; wish, desire. --2 Begging, request. --णी 1 A goldsmith's balance. --2 A probe (of iron or steel).

s: strI, (izyate'nayA । iz gatO + lyuw + svArTe kan tato wAp itvaYca .) svarRakArAdInAM tulA । nikti iti BAzA । tatparyyAyaH । nArAcI 2 । ityamaraH ॥
m: एषणिका f. a goldsmith's scale, L.

m: एषणिन् mfn. seeking, striving, Nir.
a: एषणिन् — a. Seeking, striving to get.

m: एषका or एषिका, f. sg. of the dimin. of एतद्, Pāṇ. vii, 3, 47.
एष—वीर m. N. of a despised Brāhmaṇic family, Sāy. on ŚBr. xi, 2, 7, 32.

k.v: नाराची स्यादेषणिका शाणस्तु निकषः कषः। व्रश्चनःपत्रपरशुरीषिका तूलिका समे॥

v: tri॰ iza--Rini । icCO aBilAzuke । “yOvane vizayEziRAm” “baBUva yudDaM tumulaM parasparajayEziRoH” raGuH । striyAM NIp । “tadASritA hi sA jYeyA budDistasyeziRI Bavet” BA॰ va॰ 81 a॰ ।
m: एषिन् mfn. (generally ifc.) going after, seeking, striving for, desiring, AitBr.; MBh.; Ragh. &c.
a: एषिन् — a. 1 Driving, impelling. --2 Desiring, desirous of, wishing (at the end of comp.); यौबने विषयैषिणाम् R. 1. 8.

m: एषितव्य mfn. to be sought Comm. on Bādar.
to be approved Comm. on Nyāyam.
एषितृ mfn. one who seeks or strives after, desiring, Bhaṭṭ.
1. एष्ट mfn. (आ + इष्ट) obtained by offerings or oblations, VS. v, 7
(for 2. एष्ट See under एष् = आ- √ 2. इष्.)
2. एष्ट mfn. (or fr. आ-√ इष्), that which is desired or asked for, RV. i, 184, 2.
एष्टवै (Ved. inf. of आ-√ 3. इष्), ŚBr.

v: tri॰ izu vAYCAyAm tavya । vAYCanIye । “ezwavyA vahavaH putrA yadyapyeko gayAM vrajet” Su॰ ta॰ matsyapu॰ “tadDyeva brAhmaRenEzwavyam” Sata॰ brA॰ 1, 9, 3, 17 ।
m: एष्टव्य mfn. (see above) to be striven after, desirable, wished for, ŚBr.; MBh. &c.
to be approved, Sarvad.
एष्टृ mfn. hastening on, advancing, ib.
एष्टृ = एषितृ above, Bhaṭṭ.

m: एष्टि f. (see above) seeking to go towards, wish, desire, RV. vi, 21, 8; VS.

v: tri॰ iza--karmaRi Ryat । 1 vAYCanIye BAve Ryat suSrutokte “tacca SalyakarmmAzwaviDaM tadyaTA CedyaM BedyaM leKyaM veDyamezyamAhAryyaM visrAvyaM sIvyamityuktezu azwazu maDye 2 SalyakarmmaBede na॰ । “ezyezvezaRyalABe” suSru॰ “GuRopahata kAzWe veRunalanAlISuzkAlAbUmuKezvezyasya” ityuktezu tatkarmmAcaraRam । karmaRi Ryat । 4 ezaRakarmasADye tri॰ । “ezyA nAdDyaH saSalyASca vraRA unmArgiRaSca ye” suSru॰ eza gatO Ryat । 5 gantavye tri॰ । “gatEzyadivasAdyena gatirniGnI KazaQftA” nIla॰ tA॰ । iza gatO di॰ iza icCAyAM BvA॰ iza ABIkzRye kryA॰ eByaH Ryat । ezya tattadDAtvarTakarmmaRi prAcu prEzya ityeva prezyastu Iza gatihiMsAdarSanezu ityasya Ryadantasya rUpam iti BedaH ।
m: 1. एष्य mfn. (see the last) to be striven after, to be sought for, AV. xii, 2, 39; 4, 16; TāṇḍyaBr.
2. एष्य mfn. (fr. the Caus.), to be examined medically or probed, Suśr.
3. एष्य mfn. (√ इ fut.), what is to come, future, Sūryas.
a: एष्य — a. 1 To be desired or sought. --2 To be approached. --3 To be probed.

m: एष्यत् mfn. (fut. p. of √ इ) id.
a: एष्यत् — a. Future, to come; Ki. 1. 23; Śi. 1. 26.

m: एष्यत्—˚कालीय mfn. belonging to future time, future.
